name: labyrinth
source:
"When you wake up and find yourself in a labyrinth filled with strange mist, and your life is threatened at all times, what will you—?"

Facing the imminent threat of the monster named Minotaur, the lonely one is willing to lead the way for you, the brave one is willing to follow you to attack the enemy, and the calm one is willing to give you a safe place.

Escape? Use all the chips you encounter to achieve that.

—Escape?

Maybe fate has already rolled out its dice from the very beginning.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240228083217/https://bigshu.itch.io/run]Itch.io[/url]]
